# CreativeCheck

> CreativeCheck is a public creative discovery platform for creative professionals and creative businesses.

## About

CreativeCheck helps creative professionals and creative businesses create a professional public profile and become discoverable within a global creative ecosystem. It is designed for discovery, visibility and meaningful connections across creative industries.

## Current feature

- Free public professional profile creation and discovery.
- Profiles can link to existing websites, portfolios and social channels.
- Creative professionals and creative businesses can be discovered by category and location.

## Next Features

CreativeCheck is developing additional tools and services, including:

- Invoice Tool
- Contracts
- Professional Service Connection
- Legal & Business Professional Match
- AI Business Tool
- AI-supported Discovery and Matching
- Professional Insights

These are future features and are not represented as currently available.
